description: Every known failure a user can meet, in plain words, with a fix to copy. eaos/guided.py matches an error against `match` (regular expressions over the error type and text) in order; the first match is shown: `message` says what happened, `fix` what to do, `commands` what to copy, and `after` what to do if it happens again. An unknown error falls back to `unknown`, and the technical detail always goes to a log file, never to the screen.

reasons_description: Why a stage or a step of the live map did not run, or did not pass, in the person's words: each key is a stable `reason_code` written in the progress files (eaos/progress) and in run-manifest.json; eaos/progress/reasons.py reads it. An unknown code shows the sentence EAOS wrote itself. `remedy`: what EAOS does by itself about that reason after a check (eaos/pipeline/remedies.py): a tool to run (tools_check, assistant_check), stages that must be ok first (requires_ok), then the stage run again (again_from); `consent` or `needs: person` when only the person can.

engine_not_applicable.ar: هذه الأداة لا تنطبق على لغات مشروعك.
engine_not_applicable.en: This tool does not apply to your project's languages.

engine_error.ar: توقفت هذه الأداة بخطأ، وأكمل بقية الفحص.
engine_error.en: This tool stopped with an error; the rest of the check went on.

engine_partial.ar: هذه الأداة فحصت جزءًا من المشروع فقط.

no_longer_applies.ar: هذا الإصلاح لم يعد ينطبق بعد دخول الإصلاحات الأخرى.
no_longer_applies.en: This fix no longer applies once the others are in.

gates_failed.ar: فشل أحد فحوص مشروعك أو تغيّرت شاشة، فأبحث عن الإصلاح المسبّب.
gates_failed.en: One of your project's checks failed or a screen changed, so the responsible fix is looked for.

gates_passed.ar: نجحت الدفعة في كل الفحوص، فلا حاجة للبحث.
gates_passed.en: The batch passed every check, so there was nothing to look for.

nothing_kept.ar: لم ينجح أي إصلاح، فلا يوجد ما أفحصه أو أسلّمه.
nothing_kept.en: No fix passed, so there was nothing to check or hand over.

tool_failed.ar: ما انثبتت هذه الأداة؛ السبب تحت. جرّب «أعد المحاولة».
tool_failed.en: This tool did not install; the reason is below. Try Retry.

tool_unavailable.ar: هذه الأداة ما لها نسخة لجهازك، والفحص يكمل بدونها ويذكر ذلك.
tool_unavailable.en: This tool has no build for this computer; the check goes on without it and says so.

no_run_consent.ar: ما وافقت على تشغيل برنامجك في نسخة منفصلة، فقرأ الفحص الكود فقط بدون تشغيله.
no_run_consent.en: You have not agreed to run your app in a separate copy, so the check read the code alone without running it.

app_not_running.ar: ما اشتغل برنامجك في النسخة المنفصلة، فما انأخذ دليل من تشغيله؛ السبب مكتوب في live/setup.json.
app_not_running.en: Your app did not start in the separate copy, so no evidence was taken from running it; the reason is in live/setup.json.

screens_unavailable.ar: ما قدرت أفتح صفحات برنامجك لتصويرها؛ السبب مكتوب في السجل.
screens_unavailable.en: The pages of your app could not be opened to picture them; the reason is in the log.

no_architecture_map.ar: ما انرسمت خريطة البنية: أداتا CodeCharta وEmerge غير مثبتتين أو ما تقرآن لغة هذا المشروع.
no_architecture_map.en: The architecture map was not drawn: CodeCharta and Emerge are not installed, or neither reads this project's language.

no_pages.ar: برنامجك ما فيه صفحات يمشي فيها المستخدم، فما فيه رحلات تُسجَّل.
no_pages.en: Your app has no pages a user walks through, so there is no journey to record.

no_load_scenario.ar: ما فيه صفحة أو مسار في برنامجك يقدر اختبار الضغط يطلبه، فما انقاست السرعة تحت الضغط.
no_load_scenario.en: No page or route of your app is one a load test can request, so speed under load was not measured.

browser_missing.ar: متصفح Playwright غير مثبّت على هذا الجهاز، فما انفتحت صفحات برنامجك.
browser_missing.en: Playwright's browser is not installed on this computer, so your app's pages were not opened.
